name: ih-product-steward
description: Foundational product-steward skills: read what a product is and who it serves, build and maintain its personas, pillars, user journeys, and service blueprints, write BDD user stories with acceptance criteria, keep a living roadmap, package work into value increments that each deliver something the customer feels, surface edge cases and unhappy paths early, and set capacity-based, sustainable delivery dates. It owns what/why/for-whom/when and hands how-it-looks-and-feels to designer. No house roadmap, every product gets its own, written into its repo.
